verdict.rationale: Reclaim ships Scheduling Links, so a buyer can fairly ask about invitee time-zone handling. However, no evidence item addresses automatic detection of the invitee's time zone, display of slots in that zone, or DST handling. The only time-zone mention covers locking Smart Meetings at 4am in the user's own local timezone, which is a different feature.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, invitees always see slots in their own time zone — detection, display, and DST handling are automatic
